title: Kaha kulsoom ne rokar mera abbas gar hota
body:
KAHA KULSOOM NE ROKAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA, NA YUN BARBAAD HOTA GHAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA
QHALAM HOTE NA GAR SHAANE TOH KYA HOTA KHUDA JAANE, ULAT TA SHAAM KA LASHKAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA
MERE BHAYI KI GARDANPAR NA CHAALTA SHUMR KA KHANJAR, KAHAN NAIZE PAR HOTA SAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA
NA HOTA FATIMA KA LAAL GHODOON SE KABHI PAMAAL, NA PHIRTE HUM KABHI DAR DAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA
<<DIVIDER>>
BHADAKTE SHOLAY KHAIMON MEIN NA LAGTI AAG KURTON MEIN, NA KOI LOOT TA CHADAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA, NA HOTA TAUQ GARDAN MEIN NA ZANJEERE GARAN TAN MEIN, NA HOTA ZULM ABID PAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA
SAKINA KO NA MAUT AATI NA BACHCHI SELIYAN KHATI, NA KOI CHEENTA GAUHAR MERA BBAS GAR HOTA
AJAB AHSAN HAI YE MANZAR MADINE MEIN HAIN EK MEHSHAR, KE SAB ROTE HAIN YE SUNKAR MERA ABBAS GAR HOTA..
